howToMeasure.title: Chest
howToMeasure.text: Measure around the fullest part of your chest, keeping the tape level under your arms.

howToMeasure.title: Length
howToMeasure.text: Measure from the highest point of the shoulder down to the hem.

howToMeasure.title: Shoulder
howToMeasure.text: Measure straight across the back from one shoulder seam to the other.

howToMeasure.title: Sleeve
howToMeasure.text: Measure from the shoulder seam to the end of the sleeve.

faqs.question: I'm between sizes. Which should I pick?
faqs.answer: For a closer fit choose the smaller size; for a relaxed fit choose the larger one. Our linen pieces are already cut with room to breathe.

faqs.question: Will it shrink?
faqs.answer: Our cotton is pre-shrunk. Linen may relax slightly with wear; wash cold and avoid tumble drying to keep its shape.

faqs.question: Are these body or garment measurements?
faqs.answer: They are garment measurements taken flat and doubled where relevant, with a tolerance of ±1.5 cm.

howToMeasure.title: Waist
howToMeasure.text: Measure around your natural waistline, where you normally wear your trousers.

howToMeasure.title: Hip
howToMeasure.text: Measure around the fullest part of your hips with your feet together.

howToMeasure.title: Inseam
howToMeasure.text: Measure from the crotch seam down the inside of the leg to the hem.

howToMeasure.title: Leg opening
howToMeasure.text: Measure straight across the hem of the leg, laid flat.

faqs.question: Is the waist size the same as my jeans size?
faqs.answer: Our waist sizes follow standard inch sizing, so your usual jeans size is the best starting point.

faqs.question: Can I get them hemmed?
faqs.answer: Our inseam suits most heights between 165 and 185 cm. Any local tailor can shorten the hem without affecting the fit.

howToMeasure.title: Length
howToMeasure.text: Measure from the highest point of the shoulder down to the hem — our panjabi sit just below the knee.

howToMeasure.title: Shoulder
howToMeasure.text: Measure straight across the back from one shoulder seam to the other.

howToMeasure.title: Sleeve
howToMeasure.text: Measure from the shoulder seam to the end of the cuff.

faqs.question: How does the panjabi fit?
faqs.answer: A regular, straight fit with room through the chest. If you prefer a slimmer look, choose one size down.

faqs.question: Can I get the length adjusted?
faqs.answer: Yes — any local tailor can shorten the hem without affecting the side slits.
